reason: Canonical portrait comparisons show repeated facial morphology drift; hold all 20 section images until face correction passes independent review.

concept.alt: Farah and Demir compare a time trace and a frequency spectrum on a small lab kiosk.

challenge.alt: Demir compares two captures at a side terminal while preparing the frequency comparison.

takeaways.alt: Farah holds a tablet pairing a time trace with its spectrum as she sums up the two views.

epilogue.alt: Demir studies two nearly identical time traces while Farah pauses in the lab doorway with a wry smile.

concept.alt: Demir checks the capture metadata while Farah locates a bin on a two-peak spectrum.

challenge.alt: Demir works out the strongest eligible frequency at a compact lab terminal.

takeaways.alt: Farah reviews the relationship between sampled waves and frequency bins at a small instrument.

epilogue.alt: Farah gently catches Demir's wrist and draws his attention to a small fifth peak.

concept.alt: Farah slides a short analysis window across a waveform above an intermittent frequency band.

challenge.alt: Demir builds successive spectrogram windows at a lab workbench.

takeaways.alt: Farah and Demir compare short-window and long-window spectrogram views on a tablet.

epilogue.alt: Farah measures the gap between spectrogram dashes while ARIA's waveform remains beside the display.

concept.alt: Farah identifies a fixed frequency band while Demir assembles a consistent feature row.

challenge.alt: Demir extracts an ordered band of FFT features at an engineering terminal.

takeaways.alt: Nazari and Farah check that feature columns keep the same meaning across captures.

epilogue.alt: Nazari adds 87 beside Demir's predicted 85 as he tries to suppress a pleased smile.

concept.alt: Farah compares a signal, a smooth taper, and the signal with softened edges.

challenge.alt: Demir and Nazari inspect how tapering reduces distant leakage while broadening the main peak.

takeaways.alt: Demir reviews two overlapping tapered windows on a tablet.

epilogue.alt: Farah pins her first physical spectrum print while Demir notices the unusual choice with a small smile.
